verdict.rationale: LocalAI's own CLI can list gallery models (`local-ai models list`) and fetch and run models directly from Hugging Face or Ollama URIs (`local-ai run ...`). That covers browsing and downloading, but there is no evidence of a dedicated search command or of managing installed models from the CLI, such as removing, updating or listing local installs. missing for 10: CLI search/filter command, CLI management of installed models (delete/update/inspect), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search, download, and manage models from a command-line interface

citations.quote: local-ai models list          # List available models in the gallery
